- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 6 cups chicken broth
- 1 lb cooked chicken, shredded
- 8 oz egg noodles
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Parsley for garnish
